# Repository Instructions

## Push Change Log

- Before pushing commits to any remote branch, update `changelog/CHANGELOG.md`.
- Record every commit included in the push with its short hash and a concise summary of the user-visible or operational changes.
- Group commits under the push date and target branch. Mention relevant validation when it was run.
- Include the changelog update in the same push as the changes it documents.
- Do not claim that a push was documented or completed unless the changelog entry was committed and the push succeeded.
